name: L'Ermitage Beverly Hills
insider_take: This intimate Beverly Hills gem feels more like a sophisticated European boutique hotel than a typical LA luxury property, with its rooftop garden oasis offering stunning city views just steps from Rodeo Drive.
whats_special: L'Ermitage is the only all-suite hotel in Beverly Hills, featuring a magical rooftop garden with 360-degree views of the city and mountains. The property boasts one of the highest staff-to-guest ratios in Los Angeles, ensuring ultra-personalized service. Each suite includes a private balcony, and the hotel's intimate size (just 119 suites) creates an exclusive, residential atmosphere.
pro_tip: Request a suite on the higher floors facing south for breathtaking views of the Hollywood Hills and downtown LA skyline, especially spectacular at sunset from your private balcony.
dont_miss: The rooftop garden and pool area - it's one of Beverly Hills' best-kept secrets with panoramic views and a tranquil escape from the bustling streets below. The hotel is also perfectly positioned for exploring the Golden Triangle, with world-class shopping on Rodeo Drive just a 2-minute walk away.
pros: Intimate boutique luxury with only 116 suites
Prime Beverly Hills location near Rodeo Drive
Rooftop pool and spa with city views
cons: Smaller boutique property may lack resort amenities
